runtime_status: Not implemented or enabled by this artifact; no new public type exports, tables, migrations, emitters or provider subscriptions.

notation.purpose: Machine-readable specification of fields and invariants, not a JSON Schema file or a claim of executable validation.
notation.requirement: required fields must be present, using explicit null where allowed; required_when conditions must be enforced by implementation adapters.
notation.nullable: Null means unknown/not applicable as described, never implicit zero or success.
notation.identity: opaque_token is a bounded validated internal identifier; a token format never grants authorization.
notation.money: signed_integer_string and exact_decimal_string forbid binary floating-point conversion and negative zero; units/scales are explicit.
notation.additional_properties: Reporting projections and nested objects use closed allowlists. Export permission is independently restricted by H04.
notation.runtime_validation_owner: PAI-C02/C03/C06/C07/C09/C11; H05 will supply offline fixture validation separately.

account_id.meaning: Source account/project/connection namespace; for Renvani, the approved application instance namespace.

resource_type.meaning: Approved source object kind; vendor export excludes end-customer/staff resources.

object_id.meaning: Stable native object ID; namespaced key also includes environment and the other source_ref fields.

entity_type.meaning: Approved canonical type such as estimate, estimate_option_set, job, invoice or payment.

record_version.meaning: Actual source version; absence is a quality gap.

freshness.meaning: Assessed against accepted per-source policy and cutoff.

source_configuration_version.meaning: Exact source configuration at the query cutoff.

account_id.meaning: Verified provider account/project/application namespace; not credentials.

schema_version.meaning: Version of the logical reporting contract; 1.0.0 in this package.

record_id.meaning: Stable identity of one logical record; never a random value on each import.

record_revision.meaning: Monotonic accepted analytical revision, not a new business occurrence.

supersedes_revision.meaning: Immediately preceding accepted revision of the same record, or null for revision 1.

record_status.meaning: Accepted current fact or explicit analytical retraction; untrusted/unmapped records stay in a separate internal exception path.

company_id.meaning: Server-verified Renvani company. Non-null for company records; null is allowed only for explicitly platform-scoped source-health/shared-cost records.

environment.meaning: Application environment; production, staging, development and test remain distinct.

source_ref.meaning: Closed source-identity object. It is a pointer, not a provider payload or user-supplied URL.

source_schema_version.meaning: Actual source schema/API version when known; null remains an explicit coverage limit.

source_revision.meaning: Verified source object version, event receipt version or immutable snapshot digest; do not invent from ingestion time.

adapter_version.meaning: Version of the deterministic source-to-reporting mapping.

occurred_at.meaning: Business effective/occurrence time, separate from observation and load time.

source_updated_at.meaning: Source update time if the source provides reliable update semantics.

ingested_at.meaning: Time this reporting revision was accepted for ingestion.

source_cutoff_at.meaning: Last verified source-coverage cutoff; null means unknown (for example failed/never-observed source health), requires freshness=unknown and cannot support a complete current metric claim. Ingestion time is never a substitute.

provenance_kind.meaning: Origin of the underlying business fact, not whether this analytical delivery used backfill/import/replay. Reconciled historical provider receipts retain their original financial period; historical CRM face values alone do not prove cash or intervention outcomes.

import_batch_ref.meaning: Approved internal import-lineage pointer when provenance is imported; do not include original customer/staff IDs.

quality_state.meaning: Independent completeness, freshness, reconciliation and finality dimensions.

record_contracts.name: rpt_company_identity_v1
record_contracts.grain: One verified effective company/provider-object mapping interval.

mapping_id.meaning: Stable mapping interval identity; record_id may equal mapping_id.

mapping_role.meaning: Relationship of provider resource to Renvani company.

valid_from.meaning: Inclusive start of verified mapping validity.

valid_to.meaning: Exclusive end, or open-ended null; validity intervals must not overlap for competing owners.

plan_id.meaning: Plan at this effective interval, only if source-backed.

plan_version.meaning: Versioned plan definition; do not overwrite historical plan meaning.

company_size_band.meaning: Approved coarse size band, not staff or payroll rows.

region_code.meaning: Approved coarse region, never a service/customer street address.

invariants: company_id is non-null and verified from a trusted server boundary.
A platform Stripe account serves many merchants and is not a one-account-to-one-company mapping.
Provider tuple plus mapping_role has at most one owner at an effective instant.
Unknown historical ownership remains unresolved; current IDs do not prove past ownership.
Company changes require a new verified interval and reproducible restatement; do not silently reassign history.
implementation_gaps: Mapping validity history and account/mode proof are not supplied by current company columns alone.

record_contracts.name: rpt_financial_posting_v1
record_contracts.grain: One classified signed financial component posting, reversal or adjustment.

posting_id.meaning: Canonical classified posting identity; stable across imports.

source_component_key.meaning: Names the unique component within one scoped source object; created deterministically by the adapter.

financial_component.meaning: Component vocabulary owned by H02; unclassified remains excluded from financial totals.

amount_minor.meaning: Exact signed minor units; no floating-point conversion.

currency.meaning: Original currency; currencies are never silently combined.

financial_basis.meaning: Meaning of this posting; not inferred from its sign.

posting_effect.meaning: Original economic component, actual reversal or documented adjustment.

posting_status.meaning: Provider/business confirmation state; pending/failed values cannot be collected cash.

reverses_posting_id.meaning: Original posting for an actual economic reversal; analytical revision uses record_revision instead.

adjustment_target_component.meaning: Target component of a classified adjustment; unknown target is quarantined.

adjustment_reason_code.meaning: Registered reason, never arbitrary provider error/description text.

classification_rule_version.meaning: Version of the H02 classification implemented by the adapter.

related_source_refs.meaning: Closed references such as charge, payment, fee, refund, balance transaction or platform subscription; no customer/staff/contact payloads.

payment_id.meaning: Validated application payment link when it exists.

invoice_id.meaning: Validated application invoice link; posting can exist before invoice allocation.

pricing_policy_version.meaning: Effective policy evidence, not a substituted expected fee.

pricing_evidence_ref.meaning: Approved pointer to actual fee/subscription evidence.

invariants: company_id is required for company-attributable records; unassigned records remain internal exceptions.
Provider event ID deduplicates delivery; source_component_key deduplicates economic components across object mirrors.
Refund/reversal and original component remain separate signed postings; do not sum an original plus its latest net object total.
Historical actual fee records determine the amount; 5% direction and 2% source code do not overwrite actual amounts.
Reconciliation compares the same owner/account/currency/basis/component/time cutoff.
Tax, tip, surcharge, merchant money, movements and platform receipts remain separate components.
existing_source_reuse: payments/invoices source references and exact decimal strings
actual Stripe object references through the existing payment boundary
implementation_gaps: Provider object and Connect coverage, mutable updates, component allocation and live reconciliation remain C05-C08.

record_contracts.name: rpt_workflow_opportunity_v1
record_contracts.grain: One canonical eligible recovery episode captured before treatment/selection.

opportunity_id.meaning: One recovery episode for one canonical estimate or option set; not one recommendation/message/retry.

workflow_id.meaning: Existing workflow family identity, e.g. the approved estimate-recovery family.

canonical_target_ref.meaning: Verified estimate or estimate-option-set identity; option rows do not multiply opportunities.

eligibility_rule_version.meaning: Version of the approved eligibility policy.

eligible_at.meaning: First qualifying instant for this episode under the accepted rule.

feature_set_version.meaning: Approved pre-decision feature definition, or null when no feature set is supplied.

feature_as_of.meaning: Latest business-data cutoff of the pre-decision features; cannot include post-decision outcomes.

feature_snapshot_ref.meaning: Internal minimized snapshot pointer; not permission to export arbitrary feature payloads.

selection_state.meaning: Selection is distinct from later proposal approval.

selection_reason_code.meaning: Allowlisted decision reason when known; absent information remains null.

policy_version.meaning: Selection/authority policy used; a label never grants permission.

maturity_policy_id.meaning: Named outcome-window policy; null blocks mature-cohort claims.

maturity_start_at.meaning: Start defined by the versioned maturity rule.

maturity_end_at.meaning: End defined by the versioned maturity rule; do not invent a universal window.

evaluation_population_ref.meaning: Internal full eligibility query manifest, including unselected and pending opportunities.

source_population_complete.meaning: True only after complete traversal/reconciliation for the declared snapshot.

observation_cutoff_at.meaning: Source cutoff used to assess outcomes, not current wall clock alone.

invariants: Every eligible opportunity is retained, including unselected, declined, failed, unanswered and pending.
An episode ID is fixed before recommendation; repeated scans/assists do not create new opportunities.
Re-entry requires an approved recurrence/episode policy, explicit prior-episode link and new pre-decision snapshot.
Imported estimates may be eligible after cutover, but imported historical outcomes remain baseline.
Missing eligibility or maturity policy makes the affected metric unavailable; it does not turn missing rows into zero.
existing_source_reuse: revenue-agent proposal flow only as a candidate source, not a complete denominator
implementation_gaps: Complete durable eligibility snapshots, recurrence policy, treatment-independent denominator and accepted windows need C09.

record_contracts.name: rpt_workflow_fact_v1
record_contracts.grain: One immutable lifecycle occurrence, with versioned analytical corrections to its representation.

event_id.meaning: Stable namespaced native event/receipt identity; same import delivery uses same ID.

event_type.meaning: Normalized semantic observation from event_types below; not a new DB enum by this document.

source_event_type.meaning: Original typed source event when available; does not override receipt evidence.

event_schema_version.meaning: Version of the normalized event contract.

opportunity_id.meaning: Verified opportunity link; null excludes a fact from recovery-cohort numerator.

opportunity_link_state.meaning: Distinguishes a real link, missing link, and non-opportunity company event.

workflow_run_id.meaning: Existing durable workflow execution/run identity when available.

recommendation_id.meaning: Source recommendation identifier where relevant; many may assist one opportunity.

action_id.meaning: Existing authorized action identity for proposal/approval/execution facts.

attempt_id.meaning: Stable real execution-attempt identity; required for attempt facts, never derived from ingestion retry count.

policy_version.meaning: Actual policy at decision/execution time; unknown remains null.

release_version.meaning: Observed release/adapter build tied to occurrence; never use current deploy version retroactively.

evidence_version.meaning: Version of the source evidence mapping used to establish this fact.

actor_type.meaning: Category only; no staff/customer IDs or names required for analytics.

disposition_code.meaning: Typed response/failure/reason, with raw content excluded.

financial_posting_id.meaning: Canonical posting reference for collected/refunded/adjusted observations; value is summed from posting/allocation, not event copies.

assist_product_ids.meaning: Non-additive assistance tags; native product IDs retained via a documented presentation mapping.

applicable_stage_policy_version.meaning: Defines stages that can be skipped/not applicable without fabricating success.

eligibility_snapshot_id.meaning: Required non-null for workflow.eligible; references the pre-decision eligibility snapshot.

activation_milestone_id.meaning: Required for derived company.value_reached when activation is enabled.

activation_milestone_version.meaning: Exact approved definition for a derived activation fact; null for non-activation facts.

cohort_id.meaning: Company activation cohort reference for company readiness/value observations.

invariants: company_id is non-null; every referenced entity belongs to the same verified company and environment.
Approval, queued work, actual attempt, internal completion, provider acknowledgement, delivery, response, booking, completion and collection have different event types.
An agent.execution_succeeded audit with a queued outbound receipt maps to workflow.execution_queued only.
A missing stage is unknown or explicitly not_applicable; it cannot be inferred as passed from a later timestamp.
Correction changes the analytical revision; a real cancellation/refund is a distinct business fact.
Business-event replay updates reporting only and cannot invoke action executors.
existing_source_reuse: estimate/job state transitions and payment references
implementation_gaps: Universal attempt/release/opportunity IDs and provider delivery evidence are not guaranteed by current source; adapters must expose gaps.

record_contracts.name: rpt_outcome_allocation_v1
record_contracts.grain: One allocated destination or explicit remainder in a complete versioned allocation set for one signed source component.

allocation_set_id.meaning: Stable set identity for one source posting and one allocation basis.

allocation_set_revision.meaning: One accepted complete set revision; never combine rows from multiple revisions.

allocation_id.meaning: Stable destination/remainder identity within the set.

allocation_role.meaning: The explicit remainder is a row even when zero.

source_posting_revision.meaning: Exact accepted source revision to which conservation applies.

source_component_key.meaning: Must equal the source posting component key.

allocated_amount_minor.meaning: Signed allocation or remainder in exact original minor units.

opportunity_id.meaning: A verified recovery opportunity, when linked.

allocation_basis.meaning: Approved exact link or allocation rule; unallocated remainder has its explicit basis.

allocation_state.meaning: Accepted only after the whole set passes signed conservation and scope.

supersedes_allocation_set_revision.meaning: Prior set revision, or null for the first.

complete_allocation.meaning: True only for accepted set with zero remainder and complete required source/target evidence.

invariants: Each accepted set contains exactly one unallocated_remainder row.
Sum(allocated_amount_minor for allocated rows) + remainder = exact signed source amount.
Every nonzero allocation and remainder has source sign; sum(abs(allocated rows)) <= abs(source amount).
Source and all targets share company, environment, currency and currency exponent.
Allocated rows have at least one validated outcome/job/invoice target; remainder has none.
Refunds have their own negative source posting and negative allocations; never manufacture a fee refund from a principal refund.
Allocation revision replaces a complete prior set atomically; it is not a second economic transaction.
Nonzero remainder remains visible and prevents complete-allocation claims.
existing_source_reuse: Existing RCI canonical-economic identity and exact signed allocation concepts
foundation-math.allocateMoney only for approved 2dp synthetic/read scopes
implementation_gaps: Real component/target reconciliation and atomic allocation-set revisions require C07/C09; variable-exponent adapter requires reviewed extension.

record_contracts.name: rpt_usage_cost_v1
record_contracts.grain: One actual invocation attempt (including observed zero-cost or unknown-billing attempts), or one adopted direct/shared expense representation; alternative copies are not additive.

usage_id.meaning: Canonical actual usage/expense identity independent of its imported trace copy.

usage_kind.meaning: Separates direct attempt from shared-pool allocation.

invocation_id.meaning: Logical AI invocation; required for invocation_attempt.

attempt_id.meaning: Stable real provider-request attempt; required for invocation_attempt even if billing is zero or unknown. Separately billable retries retain their own cost evidence.

trace_id.meaning: Primary trace identity; not the usage-cost dedup key by itself.

opportunity_id.meaning: Verified opportunity linkage; unlinked costs remain visible.

model.meaning: Actual provider model identifier when applicable.

model_version.meaning: Actual model version when observable; unknown remains null.

input_tokens.meaning: Observed usage quantity; null means unknown, not zero.

cached_input_tokens.meaning: Observed cache quantity under provider semantics.

latency_ms.meaning: Measured latency under a named clock/boundary definition.

latency_definition_version.meaning: Defines time-to-response/full completion and retry handling.

failure_class.meaning: Typed error category; no raw error text.

amount_decimal.meaning: Cost in currency major units at preserved precision: positive expense, negative cost refund/credit, null unknown. Convert money-to-owner-signed processor-expense postings by flipping sign exactly once; never count both representations.

decimal_scale.meaning: Exact stored precision; scale is not forced to 2.

currency.meaning: Null only when cost is unknown; otherwise original cost currency.

cost_component.meaning: AI/provider/infrastructure/etc. component under adopted H02 definition.

cost_representation_id.meaning: Identifies this measurement/estimate/allocation for the same expense.

adopted_cost.meaning: Only one authoritative adopted representation per canonical usage+component+period can enter totals.

expense_pool_id.meaning: Required for allocation; prevents adding a shared pool to its allocated copies.

cost_scope.meaning: Explicit allocation scope; company requires company_id and platform requires null company_id. A shared expense pool is not silently assigned to a tenant.

invariants: Imported copies of one actual attempt deduplicate; a real billed retry is a different attempt and remains cost.
An action-lifecycle trace is not automatically an LLM invocation or billable attempt.
Missing cost cannot become zero; estimates and allocated bills are not added for the same usage.
Shared costs without a verified company allocation remain explicitly platform-scoped, not assigned to a default tenant.
Operational success, model evaluation quality and verified customer outcome remain separate.
cost_scope=company requires a verified non-null company_id; cost_scope=platform requires null company_id and separately authorized internal platform reporting purpose.

Cost amount_decimal uses expense-positive/reduction-negative sign; a negative processor_expense money-to-owner posting converts to positive cost once. Company/platform scope and adopted representation remain explicit.

Attempt/failure populations include all actual requests, not only proven billable ones. Zero cost requires evidence; unknown billing remains null, and no pre-dispatch request is fabricated from queue admission.
existing_source_reuse: Existing Langfuse audit/import adapter boundary and company references
implementation_gaps: Current audit/import traces lack complete attempt/latency/cost coverage; C01 selects one primary path and C11/C12 implement it.

record_contracts.name: rpt_source_health_v1
record_contracts.grain: One source/run/check observation for a declared account, environment and dataset scope.

health_scope.meaning: Only company scope requires company_id; platform health may be null.

source_id.meaning: Configured source dataset, not a secret key.

run_id.meaning: Unique observed ingestion or reconciliation run.

last_success_at.meaning: Last actual successful run, not last attempt.

lag_seconds.meaning: Lag relative to verified cutoff and observed clock; null if unmeasurable.

observed_record_count.meaning: Observed accepted records under this check.

unmapped_count.meaning: Unmapped identity exception count, without exporting raw exception payloads.

exception_amount_minor.meaning: Exact exception amount for one component/currency; no mixed-currency scalar.

currency.meaning: Required when exception amount is present.

currency_exponent.meaning: Required when exception amount is present.

financial_component.meaning: Required when exception financial amount is present.

status.meaning: Data-health status, never payment/action business state.

correction_checkpoint.meaning: Last accepted correction/replay checkpoint, not a command to replay operational work.

exception_absolute_amount_minor.meaning: Sum of absolute exception magnitudes for the same component/currency/exponent; signed net can cancel and never replaces this exposure.

matched_expected_record_count.meaning: Distinct records verified against the independently expected population; duplicates/extras do not raise coverage.

invariants: Unknown expected population means unknown coverage, even if an ingestion job succeeded.
Per-component/per-currency exception amounts never combine unrelated signs or bases.
Platform aggregates do not provide tenant-access control.
Source pause/replay changes reporting only; operational webhooks and action state remain independent.

When measurable, 0 <= matched_expected_record_count <= expected_record_count; zero or unknown expected population yields no coverage percentage. Preserve both signed net and absolute exception exposure.
existing_source_reuse: Existing outbox/recovery observability concepts and internal administration boundary
implementation_gaps: Analytics source-health and cutoff checks require C04/C07/C08/C16.

event_envelope.event_identity: event_id is stable for the semantic occurrence; record_revision changes only its analytical representation.
event_envelope.required_context: company_id, environment, source_ref, schema/source/evidence/adapter versions, occurred_at, ingested_at, cutoff and quality are always explicit.
event_envelope.conditional_refs: opportunity, workflow, action, attempt, release and policy identities are required when the source supports the relevant event; a missing required identity makes the fact unavailable for the corresponding verified metric.
event_envelope.unknown_release: Never attach today's release to historical events without evidence.

event_types.evidence_rule: Complete pre-decision eligibility snapshot under approved rule.
event_types.existing_source: No complete durable reporting denominator established in inspected proposal path.
event_types.caution: Do not infer from only recommended/sent/successful records.

event_types.evidence_rule: Recorded selection decision after eligibility.
event_types.existing_source: Existing proposal/candidate flow is partial evidence only.
event_types.caution: Selection is not approval or execution.

event_types.evidence_rule: Recorded non-selection decision and registered reason.
event_types.existing_source: Reporting observation needed for all eligible candidates.
event_types.caution: Retain control/capacity/declined/no-action paths without inventing failure.

event_types.evidence_rule: Persisted existing proposal linked to canonical opportunity.
event_types.existing_source: agent.proposal_created / agent_actions.
event_types.caution: Repeated proposal generation does not create another opportunity.

event_types.evidence_rule: Existing current approved action and audit proof.
event_types.existing_source: agent.proposal_approved.
event_types.caution: Customer estimate approval is a different fact; no send or outcome claim.

event_types.evidence_rule: Explicit operator proposal rejection.
event_types.existing_source: agent.proposal_rejected plus verified state.
event_types.caution: estimate.declined is customer response, not operator proposal rejection.

event_types.evidence_rule: Actual execution attempt under existing authority, not queue admission.
event_types.existing_source: Requires typed attempt evidence; current latest receipt alone may be insufficient.
event_types.caution: Import retries and repeated reads are not new attempts.

event_types.evidence_rule: Typed outbound execution receipt with outcome=queued/deliveryState=queued.
event_types.existing_source: agent.execution_succeeded can carry this queued receipt.
event_types.caution: This does not prove a provider request, acceptance or delivery.

event_types.evidence_rule: Internal action durable side effect committed with accepted succeeded receipt.
event_types.existing_source: agent-action receipt for internal execution only.
event_types.caution: Outbound queued receipt must never map here by event name alone.

event_types.evidence_rule: Persisted failed attempt receipt and source evidence.
event_types.existing_source: agent.execution_failed / failed executionReceipt when recorded.
event_types.caution: Unknown/unrecorded attempts remain coverage gaps.

event_types.evidence_rule: Verified provider acknowledgement linked to the actual request.
event_types.existing_source: Actual provider callback/receipt; not established by current queue receipt.
event_types.caution: Acknowledgement does not prove delivery.

event_types.evidence_rule: Verified delivery receipt under channel semantics.
event_types.existing_source: Actual provider delivery callback and scoped message/request correlation.
event_types.caution: Delivery does not prove response, booking or revenue.

event_types.evidence_rule: Verified terminal provider delivery failure.
event_types.existing_source: Actual provider failure receipt.
event_types.caution: No raw provider error body in export.

event_types.evidence_rule: Explicit unresolved delivery state at observation cutoff.
event_types.existing_source: Known request with no conclusive delivery evidence.
event_types.caution: Unknown is not failed and not delivered.

event_types.evidence_rule: Correlated received response or customer estimate disposition.
event_types.existing_source: message.received or estimate.approved/declined after verified relationship.
event_types.caution: No message content/contact data exported; response is not booking.

event_types.evidence_rule: Authoritative accepted booking/schedule with verified opportunity-to-job link.
event_types.existing_source: job.scheduled plus existing booking evidence, subject to C09/C10 adapter checks.
event_types.caution: estimate.converted/job.created alone proves creation, not scheduled booking.

event_types.evidence_rule: Authoritative cancellation of the linked booking/job.
event_types.existing_source: booking.cancelled/job.cancelled after scope and meaning checks.
event_types.caution: Preserve observed historical booking and current cancellation separately.

event_types.evidence_rule: Current authoritative completed-work fact with versioned completion evidence.
event_types.existing_source: job.completed from tenant-scoped domain service.
event_types.caution: No cash-collection or margin inference.

event_types.evidence_rule: Authoritative correction invalidating a previous completion.
event_types.existing_source: Actual domain correction/reopen evidence; adapter mapping remains required.
event_types.caution: Current job.reopened can mean cancellation reopened; do not automatically treat as completion reversal.

event_types.evidence_rule: Confirmed reconciled merchant service-principal posting with accepted allocation.
event_types.existing_source: Actual payment/provider evidence; payment.received is a signal, not sufficient financial proof.
event_types.caution: Do not sum lifecycle event values in addition to financial/allocation records.

event_types.evidence_rule: Actual signed principal-refund posting and accepted allocation.
event_types.existing_source: payment.refunded plus provider/refund/component reconciliation.
event_types.caution: No automatic platform-fee refund; partial refunds stay partial.

event_types.evidence_rule: Actual classified signed economic adjustment.
event_types.existing_source: Authoritative component-specific financial source.
event_types.caution: An analytical mapping correction is a record revision, not new money.

event_types.evidence_rule: Accepted backend readiness milestone under approved cohort policy.
event_types.existing_source: Existing readiness facts only when C10 confirms them.
event_types.caution: Account creation, login or paid subscription alone need not equal ready.

event_types.evidence_rule: Derived first accepted workflow milestone with source fact and definition version.
event_types.existing_source: Governed milestone derived from existing workflow facts.
event_types.caution: No sent-message-only activation; completed and paid stages remain separate.

supporting_input_contracts.name: platform_subscription_item_input_v1
supporting_input_contracts.constraint: MRR uses an as-of contract snapshot, not a cash posting. H02 owns exact price/discount/status rules; H04 independently permits fields. discount_version identifies effective source discount state; discount_policy_version identifies the adopted MRR calculation policy. They are different evidence. Trial interval requires its actual start/end. Unknown collection pause or price support remains an exception; no raw price/tier/transform object is exported.

supporting_input_contracts.name: company_activation_input_v1
supporting_input_contracts.constraint: Cohort origin is preserved after later cancellation; rates require accepted maturity policy and expose pending/unknown. Repeated use requires a different canonical opportunity. No universal duration is invented.

reporting_query_metadata.period_rule: Half-open [start,end) UTC boundaries resolved from the selected IANA timezone; DST/timezone changes cannot relabel historical source instants silently.
reporting_query_metadata.query_scope_rule: H04 role/purpose boundaries constrain outputs; PostHog groups/filters are not authorization.
constraints: Use H02 canonical metadata names. Snapshot/as-of metrics still declare their applicable period/instant in the query manifest; period bounds are null only when the accepted metric explicitly has no interval.
cohort_id and cohort_definition_version are null together for non-cohort metrics; never fabricate a cohort for an as-of source check.
configuration and account-mode arrays are closed, bounded and deduplicated; registry IDs cannot contain user text or connection strings.
computation_truncated must equal quality_state.computation_truncated. Display-only truncation does not certify computation completeness.
source_cutoff_at cannot exceed generated_at; unknown cutoff prevents a fresh/complete claim.
currency_or_unit is bound to the accepted metric and exact representation, not arbitrary text or an implicit FX conversion.
H06/C06/C11 must bind closed per-metric scalar/vector/distribution output schemas before exporting result payloads; no unbounded generic result JSON is approved here.

query_manifest_binding.location: Internal controlled Renvani evidence boundary; the external query_manifest_ref is an opaque pointer only.
query_manifest_binding.identity: Immutable versioned manifest identity; referenced population/filter snapshots are immutable under the accepted retention/correction policy.
required_bindings: exact resolved company set or immutable complete population snapshot, including inclusion/exclusion and cohort membership
actual resolved filter values plus their accepted definition/version; filter_version alone is insufficient
period/as-of instant, timezone, currency/unit/basis, environment and account/live-test scope
accepted source configurations, record-revision set and verified cutoff for each required source
metric/query versions, matched/expected coverage, computation-truncation state and result revision
producing server authorization context and its version, kept internally rather than copied to PostHog
query_manifest_binding.authorization_rule: A manifest reference, cohort ID or Stripe account never grants company access. Current result/detail requests reauthorize and may return only the intersection permitted by the actual current scope; no silent scope broadening. A scope mismatch requires a new appropriately scoped query/result, not relabeling an old aggregate.
query_manifest_binding.failure_rule: Missing verified scope denies access. Missing/incomplete/mutable-only population/filter/source binding prevents a complete reproducible result; no fallback to all companies or current mutable membership.
query_manifest_binding.reuse: Extend existing RCI scope/read binding and queryManifest concepts through the reviewed adapter; no new general query engine or public runtime export is introduced.

compatibility.reuse: Scope binding, source/fact quality, period/basis, evidence provenance and non-executing claim concepts.
compatibility.limit: scopeSchema is shape-only; source kinds omit Stripe/AI types; PA-M IDs are not registered; no direct drop-in compatibility claim.

compatibility.reuse: Existing Decimal dependency, exact signed money allocation, missing-cost and deduplication invariants where applicable.
compatibility.limit: Current money and allocateMoney helpers are fixed to 2 decimal places; variable minor-unit exponent and AI micro-cost need reviewed versioned adapter/extension, not forced rounding.

compatibility.reuse: Read existing stable activity-event rows and preserve operational emitters.
compatibility.limit: Emitter is a database write helper, not a universal durable reporting transport or deduplication ledger.

compatibility.reuse: Existing registered operation, tenant, retry and checkpoint architecture where an analytics operation is appropriate.
compatibility.limit: Reporting replay must use its read/export path, never an operational send/charge/action retry.
